scope: Only the specified punctuation windows were visually checked; this is not whole-page proofreading.

decisions.evidence: Printed dialogue Кузе туге?!. uses the same combined punctuation.
Printed letter ends thanks with тау!.., then starts Ала-молан. Preserve author punctuation.
Only the closing question а тый?.. is verified against print; corrupt words earlier in this record are not approved.
Printed dialogue салам!.. and логалын огыдал?.. matches exclamation/question plus ellipsis.
Printed internal question ӱдырем?.. and apology Извинитлыза!.. retain ellipses.
Printed dialogue Роза!.. and каникул кузе ок лий?!. uses combined punctuation. These are not false sentence boundaries.
Printed Тугай ӱдыр!.. has an exclamation followed by ellipsis.
Printed question лӱдеш дыр?!. retains question, exclamation and trailing dot.
Printed address Картошкин йолташ!.. retains exclamation and ellipsis; this decision does not certify other words in the record.
Printed ыштыш?.. retains question plus ellipsis; unrelated corrupt letters in the record remain outside this decision.
Printed letter таум каласем!.. retains exclamation and ellipsis.
Printed publishing abbreviations Усл. печ. л., Усл. кр.-отт., Учетно-изд. л. contain real periods. Do not treat these periods as OCR noise.
Printed dialogue А Роза... нигушкат uses ellipsis before lowercase continuation.
Printed hesitant dialogue мый... мый... repeats the lowercase pronoun after ellipses.
Printed пурен кертеш?!. and йӧным муынат!.. match source punctuation.
Printed савырен кертат!.. and Молан мылам качыже?.. match source punctuation.
Printed repeated address Лидия! Лидия!.. contains an exclamation followed by ellipsis.
Printed dialogue лудат?!., ойлыштыда?!., вожыл?!. uses combined question/exclamation punctuation.
Printed internal quotation ends шындылеш?.. followed by closing quotation mark.
Printed Яра кияш оҥай мо?!. matches combined punctuation.
Printed ом тӱҥал!.. matches exclamation plus ellipsis.
Printed direct address Эргым, тол!.. matches punctuation.
Printed letter ends question кушто ила гын?.. with ellipsis.
